# Model card: Document injection classifier

| | |
|---|---|
| Purpose | Find paraphrased instructions in a whole document, which have no trigger word for the deterministic detectors. |
| Workflow | core (used by Hire) |
| Code | `pairly_core.guardrails.doc_classifier.classify_document`; Hire runs it on every CV (`pairly_hire.screening.pipeline.HIRE_CLASSIFIER`) |
| Prompt | `guardrails_document_classify` version `v1`, file SHA-256 `b3c9b5d8a572699a...` |
| Output schema | `DocumentInjectionSpans` |
| Model tiers, cheapest first | `small` (anthropic `claude-haiku-4-5-20251001`, openai `gpt-6-luna`) |
| Temperature | 0.0 |
| Output token limit | 1024 |
| Confidence threshold to accept | none |

## Inputs

The document text split into numbered segments, each a JSON string with its offset, inside an untrusted-document frame.

## Outputs

`DocumentInjectionSpans`: spans with offsets and quotes. A span must exist in the text or it is dropped.

## Human oversight

It can only add findings. In Hire a failure flags the CV for a person (`on_failure = block`).

## Limits

* Paraphrased attacks are the hardest case; recall needs a live model to measure.
* Long documents beyond the call limit get a `classifier_unavailable` finding.
* Every call is logged in `model_calls` (prompt version and hash, model, inputs, output, tokens, cost) and fails closed: no model means a person does the step.

## Evals

Numbers come only from result files committed in `evals/results/`, exactly as written there. See [evals.md](../evals.md) for what each run measures. In the gated files (`hire.json`, `pay.json`) a model metric stays pending until thresholds are set for it; live numbers are read from the `*_live.json` files, which do not gate.

| Metric | Value | Over | Run | Source |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Attack payloads reaching the scoring model without the classifier | 5 | 5 paraphrased payloads |  | `hire.json` `injection.scoring_input_payload_leaks.classifier_scope_without_classifier.leaks` |
| Payload leaks with the classifier (recorded run) | pending a live run |  |  | `hire.json` `injection.scoring_input_payload_leaks.classifier_scope` |
| Classifier recall, payload removed (live run) | 0.6 | 5 attacks | complete | `hire_live.json` `injection.recall_payload_removed` |
| Paraphrased payloads still in the model input (live run) | 2 | 5 payloads | complete | `hire_live.json` `injection.payloads_left_in_model_input` |
| Classifier false-positive rate on clean CVs (live run) | 0.0 | 20 clean CVs | complete | `hire_live.json` `injection.false_positive_rate` |

* Attack payloads reaching the scoring model without the classifier: Shows what the classifier must catch.
* Paraphrased payloads still in the model input (live run): In Hire a CV where the classifier could not run is flagged for a person; the file lists them under `missed` and `classifier_unavailable`.
